note: The durable part of the agent search path. Routing intent -> provider lives HERE, in data, not in code. search.py reads this file; edit it to change behaviour. Credential VARIABLE NAMES (never values) also live here, matching the application env file.

tavily.best_at: answering a question from the index
tavily.why: Tavily synthesises a direct answer with sources, which is what an answer-shaped question wants.

exa.best_at: finding pages nobody has named yet
exa.why: Exa is neural search over page content: it discovers supplier/vendor/source pages and returns their text.

spider.best_at: reading a known URL that may be bot-walled or JS-rendered
spider.why: Spider renders and unblocks a known URL; it fetched an eBay page that Jina could only see as a 403 wall.

rules.why: a caller-supplied URL is a fetch, not a search: Spider renders and unblocks it
query carries discovery intent (find/search/suppliers/sources): Exa finds pages nobody has named
query is answer-shaped (question word, trailing '?', price/compare): Tavily synthesises an answer
a bare noun phrase is a discovery query by default
